theorems.name: Submission.p03_eds_torsion_kernel_sum_68cf3476_d4
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] [DecidableEq k] (W : WeierstrassCurve k), W.Δ ≠ 0 → ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∀ S : Finset W.toAffine.Point, (∀ P : W.toAffine.Point, P ∈ S ↔ n • P = 0) → S.sum (fun P => P) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Uses accepted negation-cancellation and two-torsion lemmas, splitting on the parity of n.
